title: Simon Willison's PyCon US 2026 Lightning Talk
description: Simon Willison gave a lightning talk at PyCon US 2026 with annotated slides using his presentation tool, covering LLM predictions and AI-assisted programming topics.
author: Simon Willison

title: All in on AI: Coding with LLMs - Simon Willison's Evolving Workflow
description: YouTube video covering Simon Willison's tools that can execute code and demonstrating 'vibe-coding' with Claude Code, showing his evolving AI-assisted programming workflow.
author: Simon Willison

title: Three Types of Programmers in 2026
description: Karpathy discussed how the role of programmers is evolving, with context window management becoming a key skill. He emphasizes that 'what's in the context window is your lever over the interpreter, that is the LLM'.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Software 3.0 and the Evolution of Programming
description: Andrej Karpathy promotes the concept of 'Software 3.0' - a new programming layer built around prompts rather than traditional code. He explains this is not just another developer tool but a fundamental shift in how programming works.
author: Andrej Karpathy

title: Vibe Coding is the Future - Amjad Masad on Moonshots Podcast
description: Amjad Masad discussed why 'vibe coding' is not just a trend but the future of programming, sharing insights on AI coding impact on engineering teams and the post-coding AI era.
author: Amjad Masad

title: Replit Raises $400M Series D at $9B Valuation
description: Replit raised $400M in Series D funding with a $9B valuation, focusing on democratizing software creation with AI coding tools. The company has grown to 34M users with their AI coding platform.
author: Amjad Masad / Replit

title: Karpathy's Dramatic Shift in Coding Workflow
description: Andrej Karpathy revealed a dramatic shift in his programming workflow 'in just a few weeks' due to improved LLM coding capabilities. He moved from '80% manual+autocomplete coding and 20% agents' to a much more AI-assisted approach.
author: Jason Guo / Andrej Karpathy
